spec: MAHOPAC_DREAMS v0.1 (design repo, private; D1940-D1951): Mom's walk north (§4), the lens note (§3.1) and the north trail's key (DA1).
_about: Ours, not a design copy. Applied after detail_zzz_act2_cover.json. Mahopac's own objects, flags and scenes are in data/mahopac.json; this file holds what lives outside Mahopac: Mom's offer and repeats at home (DA3; data/interiors.json stays verbatim). Save stays pixelpets.save.v2, v 2; new additive story.* keys only; nothing written at load. Gates nothing in the game sets yet (story.seal4, story.seal5) keep it inert in normal play.

_placeholders.note: PLACEHOLDER copy (Story/June to replace; MAHOPAC_DREAMS §3-§5; OPEN_DECISIONS D1940-D1959). Every line in this file and every line MAHOPAC_DREAMS adds to data/mahopac.json is a placeholder.

_waits: §5.1 (D1947): spire_echo is SE1-SE2, for the Spire debrief after d3 and before the Keepers' decision scene (W only). The debrief (STORMBELL_SPIRE, REPORTS §5) is not built, so nothing runs it yet; its build adds ["run", "spire_echo"] after d3.

spire_echo: As Lumen goes, Ilse stays by the window a moment.
A bell tower at low tide. I dreamed one once. It's in my other book.

hostNotes._note: §3.1 (D1940, D1923): after the Ledger Night and the Spire, once, at any Lantern House Host; on the switcher path only after the bring-in order (story.ilse_p0). Closed at Act 6.
hostNotes.line: A note from Warden Ilse: The lens at Mahopac. Bring {pet}. Come when you can.

objPatch._note: DA1 (D1950): the north trail also opens on Ilse's note, for an old save that skipped Mahopac (no story.mom_sent); wayup's copies of the warp and signs are the ones that stand. §4.2 (D1944): Mom's offer comes first on her home tap from Seal 4 to Seal 5 (the daily snack still plays first when due); her repeat after the walk replaces Supper's for the rest of Act 2.

add.story.mom_mahopac=told & !story.seal5: Thank you for the lens, love.
add.story.mom_mahopac=held & !story.seal5: That lens. I keep thinking about it.
